description:
£130 PPPW - My Property Box are delighted to welcome to the student market this stunning duplex apartment on Orchard Place, Jesmond.

Situated just off Buston Terrace in the heart of Jesmond, this fantastic property is ideally located within walking distance of local amenities, including Acorn Road and Osborne Road. The apartment is stylishly presented throughout, featuring contemporary furnishings and modern fittings.

Arranged over two floors, the spacious accommodation benefits from a recently refurbished kitchen, complete with a dishwasher and a large fridge freezer. All three bedrooms are generously sized, featuring double beds and coming fully furnished, making this an ideal home for students.

The property also benefits from two bathrooms, offering added convenience for shared living. Externally, there is allocated permit parking to the front of the property.

To arrange a viewing, contact My Property Box today and speak to our dedicated Lettings Team!
